contents: Designed for generic automation: webhooks, HTTP requests, branching/logic, Python script execution, and AI LLM integrations
Decoupled so frontend and backend can evolve independently
Uses uv as the official Python package and virtual environment manager
SQLAlchemy 2.0 database engine supporting SQLite and PostgreSQL via DATABASE_URL, with scoped variables hierarchy and regex template interpolation
Canvas node drag auto-persistence with debounced sync to backend and VariablesModal for scoped variables CRUD

Flow folders classification, canonical multi-environment promotion pipeline (dev->qa->prd) with version incrementing and source_flow_id lineage, and 4-tier multi-environment scoped variables resolution hierarchy in FlowRunner
TopNav Environment Switcher (DEV/QA/PRD), FlowsModal folder grouping & promotion action buttons, and VariablesModal multi-environment selector

Multi-method webhook triggering (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, ANY) with query parameters ingestion for GET and fallback, method matching against WebhookTriggerComponent, and descriptive 405 Method Not Allowed handling
Conditional branch skipping in DAG runner cascading skips to downstream nodes of unselected true_branch or false_branch handles without failing flow execution
PaginatedHttpComponent implements async pagination loop supporting page_number, offset_limit, and cursor modes with break_condition and max_pages safety limit, returning consolidated all_items array
Pre-configured canvas templates if_condition_flow and paginated_api_flow in flowStore and TopNav, with skipped node badges in CustomNode and telemetry in ExecutionDrawer
Configurable webhook authentication modes (none, api_key_header, bearer, api_key_query) with customizable header and query param names, and 401 Unauthorized enforcement in FastAPI routes
FlowsModal webhook banner displays security badges and one-click Copiar cURL button generating executable commands with configured auth headers/params
Worktree folder hierarchy in FlowsModal with recursive path segmentation (/ delimiter), expandable tree nodes, flow count aggregation, folder search, and split-view navigation
Responsive FlowsModal viewport (96vw up to 1550px), Fullscreen Maximize toggle, Collapsible Worktree Sidebar, and List vs 2-Column Grid view modes with anti-clipping card wrapping
VariableComponent dual mode (get/set) with flow and global scoping, DatabaseManager upsert_variable persistence, and FlowRunner real-time propagation to custom_variables
VariableComponent environment selection ('current', 'all', 'dev', 'qa', 'prd') enables multi-stage target scoping in get and set modes without manual flow modification on promotion

Automated Chrome Puppeteer screenshot capture engine (capture-screenshots.mjs) generating real 1080p screenshots for GitHub README showcase (canvas hero, worktree flows modal, 3D variables modal, live SSE execution telemetry) and canonical open-source documentation with MIT license

DelayComponent (Delay / Sleep) provides non-blocking async execution pause (asyncio.sleep) with configurable delay and units (seconds, milliseconds, minutes), transparent payload pass-through to output handle data, and inline canvas number input controls
SwitchNodeComponent (Switch / Router) provides multi-branch routing (case_1, case_2, case_3, default_branch) with cascading branch skipping in FlowRunner, GitFork icon, and Indigo Linear dark styling

DataFilterComponent provides declarative collection filtering with comparison operators, items_path extraction, dual filtered_items and discarded_items outputs, count telemetry, Filter icon, and Emerald styling

SlackWebhookComponent provides Slack Incoming Webhook alerts with formatted text, channel overrides, custom bot identity (username, icon_emoji), Block Kit/attachments, error resilience, MessageSquare icon, and Rose styling

Categorized library of 9 showcase workflow templates in flowStore and TopNav (Basic APIs, Logic & Control Flow with Switch and Delay, Data & Alerts with Filter, Paginated HTTP, and Slack Webhook) demonstrating advanced platform orchestration capabilities

DiscordWebhookComponent provides Discord Incoming Webhook alerts with formatted content, rich Embed cards, hex color parsing, bot identity (username, avatar_url), HTTP 200/204 delivery semantics, MessageCircle icon, and Blurple styling
TelegramWebhookComponent provides Telegram Bot API outbound messaging with bot_token, chat_id, HTML/Markdown formatting, message_id return, Send icon, and Sky blue styling

EmailNotificationComponent provides non-blocking transactional email delivery via smtplib thread worker with STARTTLS, SSL/TLS, multi-recipients, HTML/plaintext MIME formatting, Mail icon, and Violet styling

DataMapperComponent provides declarative record restructuring with dot-notation path extraction, array indexing, items_path collection traversal, unmapped field passthrough, ArrowRightLeft icon, and Emerald styling

DataAggregatorComponent provides mathematical and statistical aggregations (sum, avg, min, max, count, concat) and group_by partitioning with safe numeric coercion, Calculator icon, and Emerald styling

CsvParserComponent provides bidirectional CSV parsing (text to JSON rows) and generation (JSON rows to CSV string) with customizable delimiters, header extraction, empty line filtering, FileSpreadsheet icon, and Emerald styling

DatabaseQueryComponent provides parameterized SQL execution against SQLite, PostgreSQL, or external engines with safe dict binding, fetch modes (all, one, none), non-blocking thread offloading, Database icon, and Teal styling

KeyValueStoreComponent provides persistent cross-execution state storage and atomic counters with get, set, delete, increment, and list operations, namespace isolation, HardDrive icon, and Teal styling
LoopIteratorComponent provides declarative collection chunking, batch slicing, and pagination metrics without violating DAG acyclicity, Repeat icon, and Indigo styling

TryCatchComponent provides error boundary encapsulation, upstream failure interception, fallback emission, and branching (success_branch, error_branch) with cascading branch skipping in FlowRunner, ShieldAlert icon, and Rose styling

Categorized library of 12 showcase workflow templates in flowStore and TopNav spanning 4 thematic sections (Básicos, Lógica & Controle, Dados & Alertas, Banco de Dados, Lotes & Mensageria) demonstrating native database SQL to CSV, batch processing with KV store counters & Discord, and resilient Try/Catch fallback pipelines with Telegram alerts
